edits.description: Targeted edits to the group index page, applied in this order. Only the showcase card of this molecule may be touched.

op.description: replace: swap an exact block of the card. append: add at the end of the page. There is no create — the group index always exists.

find.description: Required by replace: the exact current text, copied verbatim, occurring EXACTLY ONCE in the page.

content.description: The replacement text, the appended block, or the whole page on create.

why.description: One short line, in the user's language.
